'''Mod IV Scanner Limbs''' were a type of [[cyberscanner limb]] that incorporated [[Portable scanner/Legends|portable scanners]] and were covered with [[Synthflesh/Legends|synthflesh]].<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
